title: 第9章 出事的怎么就不是你呢？-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    这事儿当然是谢辞干的。

    既然怀疑靳泽宇和化工厂的爆炸脱不开关系，自己现在又走不开盯着他，那就把人关在一个他不能自由行动的地方呗。

    那么这个地方，自然是非橘子莫属啦。

    于是，靳泽宇和跟班正准备收拾收拾出发去偷原料，就被一群制服叔叔冲进来按在了地上。

    靳泽宇蹲在拘留室，给副厂长打完电话，又给靳建国打电话。

    不出意外，被自家老爹劈头盖脸一顿臭骂！

    这两天公司里事事不顺心，资金链莫名其妙嘎嘣一下就断了，带起的连锁反应让靳建国完全束手无策。

    好几个供应商找上门来催钱，但是他手头能用的钱连十万块都凑不出。

    就这么焦头烂额的当口，儿子还被抓进橘子了！

    靳建国一见到靳泽宇，猛冲上去抬脚就踹！

    靳泽宇被踹得连滚带爬，还听老爹各种污言秽语往外蹦，惊得一旁制服叔叔表情呆滞。

    陪着靳建国一起来，是这边的局长。

    他拦下靳建国，压低声音：

    “赶紧带回去！这两天别让小宇在外面招摇，有人要针对他！

    今晚的事情是上头有人吩咐我们去做的，你懂我意思吧？”

    靳建国表情一变，左右看看，也压低声音：“你上头的领导？”

    局长面色严肃点头。

    靳建国表情扭曲，偏头骂了很脏一句，又转回来与局长寒暄感谢后，拎着逆子回家。

    时间刚到晚上九点，街道上车水马龙，明亮的路灯一盏盏掠过，照亮靳泽宇阴沉的表情。

    “爸，我觉得这件事跟靳烂缺那个小贱人脱不了干系，你不如去问问小叔，看看是不是气运法阵出了什么问题。”

    靳建国也有这个怀疑，沉着脸说：

    “我得先稳住公司，明天晚上请你小叔来家里吃饭吧。

    你这两天给我老老实实呆在家里，哪儿也别去！”

    靳泽宇表情抽动一瞬，闷闷嗯了一声，没有反驳。

    靳建国的司机开车把靳泽宇送回到靳家所在的小区，又载着老板回公司了。

    靳泽宇站在楼下，看着汽车尾灯消失在视线中，对着手机那头的跟班冷声道：

    “过来接我，我们现在就动手！”

    *

    深夜的西郊早已陷入一片黑暗。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Of course it was Xie Ci who did this.

Since I suspect that Jin Zeyu has something to do with the explosion in the chemical plant, and I can't leave and keep an eye on him, I'd better lock him up in a place where he can't move freely.

“ Then this place must be the Orange.

So, just as Jin Zeyu and his followers were preparing to pack up and set off to steal raw materials, a group of uniformed uncles rushed in and pinned them to the ground.

Jin Zeyu squatted in the detention room, called the deputy director, and then called Jin Jianguo.

As expected, he was scolded by his own father!

In the past two days, everything in the company has not been going as planned. The capital chain was suddenly broken for no apparent reason. The chain reaction caused by this made Jin Jianguo completely helpless.

Several suppliers came to his door to press for money, but he couldn’t even raise 100,000 yuan of available money.

Just when he was so worried, his son was caught in the orange!

As soon as Jin Jianguo saw Jin Zeyu, he rushed forward and kicked him!

Jin Zeyu was kicked until he was rolling around, and he heard all kinds of dirty words from his father. He was so shocked that the uniformed uncle beside him had a dull expression.

Jin Jianguo came with him, he is the director here.

He stopped Jin Jianguo and lowered his voice:

"Take it back quickly! Don't let Xiaoyu show off outside these two days, someone is going to target him!

"What happened tonight was ordered by someone from above. Do you understand what I mean?""

Jin Jianguo's expression changed, he looked around and lowered his voice: "Your superior?"

The director looked serious and nodded.

Jin Jianguo’s expression was distorted, he tilted his head and cursed, then turned back to greet the director and thanked him, and then took his son back home.

It was just nine o'clock in the evening, and the streets were busy with traffic. Bright street lights passed by one by one, illuminating Jin Zeyu's gloomy expression.

"Dad, I think this matter has something to do with that little bitch Jin Langque. You might as well ask your uncle to see if there is something wrong with the luck formation."

Jin Jianguo also had this suspicion and said calmly:

“I have to stabilize the company first. Let’s invite your uncle to my house for dinner tomorrow night.

You stay at home for these two days and don’t go anywhere!"

Jin Zeyu’s expression twitched for a moment, and he made a muffled hum without retorting.

Jin Jianguo’s driver drove Jin Zeyu back to the community where Jin’s family lived, and then drove the boss back to the company.

Jin Zeyu stood downstairs, watching the car taillights disappear from sight, and said coldly to the follower on the other end of the phone:

“Come and pick me up, let’s do it now!”

*

Late at night, the western suburbs have already fallen into darkness.
